info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Notification Subscriptions Webhook Event Test Subscriptions-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the testing of notification subscriptions for specific webhook events. By querying this endpoint, users can retrieve test subscription details based on the specified webhook and event identifiers. This functionality is essential for developers looking to validate webhook integrations and ensure that notifications are functioning correctly before going live. Typical consumers include developers and integrations teams seeking to streamline their notification handling processes.

get.summary: Retrieve test subscriptions for a specific webhook event.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the test subscriptions associated with a particular webhook event identified by its resource. It helps developers verify the integration and ensure that the webhooks are functioning as expected.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating test subscriptions for a specific webhook event. This operation allows you to verify if the webhook is correctly configured and if notifications are being sent as expected.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of test subscriptions.

ListNotificationSubscriptionsWebhookEven.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation to retrieve test subscriptions for webhooks in the specified event context.
